description: Use this when the user asks for a kundli, janam kundli, Vedic birth chart, "kundli banao", rising sign/lagna, moon sign/rashi ("what is my rashi"), nakshatra or planetary placements, and gives birth date, time and city. Use city text only; Naksha looks the city up in memory and does not save it. Do not use for Western sun-sign horoscopes, when the user only wants a rashi from a name, or for medical, legal or financial decisions.
